eyebrow: Striping: splits one backup, no redundancy
code:
BACKUP DATABASE Sales
TO DISK = N'D:\Backup\Sales_1.bak',
   DISK = N'E:\Backup\Sales_2.bak'
WITH STATS = 10;

-- ALL files required to restore
-- lose one file, lose the entire backup set
caption: Multiple DISK = targets spread I/O across drives — this is a speed feature, not safety.

code:
BACKUP DATABASE Sales
TO DISK = N'D:\Backup\Sales_Full.bak'
MIRROR TO DISK = N'\\BackupServer\Share\Sales_Full.bak'
WITH FORMAT;

-- Enterprise Edition only
-- device counts must match, primary to mirror
caption: MIRROR TO creates a complete, independent copy — losing one still leaves a restorable backup.

steps.label: Local disk
steps.sub: fast, but shares the server's own failure modes

steps.label: Network share
steps.sub: survives losing the database server itself

steps.label: Same disk as the DB
steps.sub: zero protection if that disk fails
